1409  class KVCacheTensor:
1410      """A class for specifying how the workers should initialize the KV cache.
1411  
1412      Placement of a set of same-shaped layers in the KV cache allocation.
1413      Layer ``layers[l]``'s page for block ``b`` starts at
1414      ``offset + l * layer_stride + b * block_stride`` bytes into the backing
1415      allocation of ``size`` bytes. Layer-outermost layouts give each layer a
1416      contiguous region (``layer_stride = page * num_blocks``,
1417      ``block_stride = page``); block-outermost layouts make each block a
1418      block of all layers' pages (``layer_stride = page``, ``block_stride`` =
1419      the packed block). Tensors whose address ranges overlap
1420      alias the same bytes: cache groups overlay each other, which is sound
1421      because a block ID is owned by one group at a time.
1422      """
1423  
1424      size: int  # total size of the backing allocation in bytes
1425      layers: list[str]  # layer names in L order
1426      layer_stride: int
1427      block_stride: int
1428      offset: int = 0  # byte offset of layers[0]'s block 0
1429      host_resident: bool = False

776      def free_blocks(self, ordered_blocks: Iterable[KVCacheBlock]) -> None:
 777          """Free a list of blocks. The blocks should be ordered by their
 778          eviction priority, where the first block will be evicted first.
 779  
 780          Args:
 781              ordered_blocks: A list of blocks to free ordered by their eviction
 782                  priority.
 783  
 784          """
 785          # Identify blocks with hash (LRU cache) and without it (never match APC)
 786          blocks_to_evict_last = []
 787          blocks_to_evict_first = []
 788          other_pools: dict[BlockPool, list[KVCacheBlock]] = {}
 789          for block in ordered_blocks:
 790              if block.is_null:  # never pooled; its ref_cnt is not maintained
 791                  continue
 792              if block.pool is not None and block.pool is not self:
 793                  other_pools.setdefault(block.pool, []).append(block)
 794                  continue
 795              block.ref_cnt -= 1
 796              if block.ref_cnt == 0:
 797                  if block.block_hash is None or not self.enable_caching:
 798                      # LIFO reuse of non-cached blocks for better GPU locality.
 799                      blocks_to_evict_first.append(block)
 800                  else:
 801                      # FIFO reuse of cached blocks for LRU eviction behavior.
 802                      blocks_to_evict_last.append(block)
 803  
 804          # Blocks to reuse first are prepended to the front of the free queue.
 805          self.free_block_queue.prepend_n(blocks_to_evict_first)
 806          # Blocks to reuse last are appended to the end of the free queue.
 807          self.free_block_queue.append_n(blocks_to_evict_last)
